sources.snippet: This model is intended for research purposes. We hope it enables researchers to better understand and explore zero-shot video classification, video-text retrieval, and generalisation capabilities of video-language models.

sources.snippet: Video-Language (ViCLIP): ViCLIP models trained on LAION-BVD match or exceed InternVid-trained models by up to 4.4% on standard video-text benchmarks, with consistent improvements as training scale grows from 10M to 50M clips. sources.title: LAION
sources.snippet: LAION, as a non-profit organization, provides datasets, tools and models to liberate machine learning research. By doing so, we encourage open public education and a more environment-friendly use of resources by reusing existing datasets and models.
